safety_note: All public tests use synthetic isolated laboratory fixtures. Never assume production safety.

blocked_reason: Official isolated Supervisor Ingress rejects forged peer/header requests; native Rust product App runs nonroot (GitHub runs 40004128675 and 40002933713). Still missing authorized write sessions, per-operation revocation and production-host penetration tests.

Official Core 2026.10.2 and selected real HACS integrations passed isolated CI (runs 40004128648 and 40004128595); complete 29/29 integration lifecycles, migrations, hardware-dependent behaviors and long recovery are not validated.
Pinned integrations load in genuine isolated Core; live interactive GitHub OAuth login, token renewal, revocation, multiuser isolation and outage recovery are not certified.
Nine-App migration fixtures remain synthetic; nine representative real Supervisor Apps still require full install, start, update, stop and rollback with persistent data checks.

Actual official HAOS 18.3 QEMU has verified File Editor App data byte-for-byte partial restoration and disposable local App v1 to v2 version change then backup-based rollback after manager SIGKILL (run 40127707580). Does not certify arbitrary real third-party App database state, auth credentials or full Rust-native lifecycle parity.

Already verified in actual pinned HAOS 18.3 QEMU: full backup SHA256, full restore of mutated share bytes and official Core version IN THE SAME GUEST, encrypted full backup plus correct-password recovery, wrong-password refusal without data mutation, and genuine File Editor SHA256 partial App data restore (17/17 run 40127707580). The independent second fresh-machine disaster recovery test is separate and NOT yet verified (PR #86); full Rusty Home cross-vendor migration and household-equivalent state remain unverified.

A real QEMU disposable local App v1 to v2 downgrade after manager SIGKILL did restore exact v1 bytes and version (run 40127707580). Full host migration rollback across independent machines, complete Core states, real App DBs, user accounts, physical radios and network ownership remain NOT verified.
A synthetic cross-process Linux radio lock and SIGKILL fencing exist, but real Zigbee/Thread/Matter radio transfers and simultaneous-controller fault isolation are untested.
Real isolated Core and bounded WebSocket tests exist; multi-day reconnect, authentication renewal, packet loss, back-pressure and stale state convergence have not been certified.

Native Supervisor Ingress authenticates read-only sessions in isolated HAOS, but end-to-end per-user write RBAC, CSRF protection, one-time approvals and revocation across sessions are disabled or unproved.
No complete real-device coverage: Linux host drivers, physical radios, USB passthrough, cloud providers and native service parity with Home Assistant remain unqualified.
Native Rust microbenchmarks and isolated Core scale are not whole-home representative. Real 24h+ soak, peak workloads, memory, crash recovery and hardware resource regression remain.

Real disposable .deb install, upgrade, downgrade, purge and offline signed APT tamper rejection passed on main (run 40004128778). Still missing release signing infrastructure, published packages, service migration and rollback on an existing installation.

Six external crates without bundled license files now have version-matched upstream source texts; the full Cargo.lock source SPDX is reproducible and Sigstore-attested (run 40027460088). Still missing independently reviewed binary-release BOM, all source/asset/firmware copyright notices, redistribution obligations and formal legal approval.

Four genuine production Rust surfaces, including seven-action App preflight, passed sanitizer-instrumented pinned libFuzzer smoke (run 40026397117); not a complete security audit. Still missing independent penetration tests, cross-service attacker modeling, privilege-escalation review, broad fuzz coverage, prolonged stress and remediation retests.
